function_declarations.name: issue_card
function_declarations.description: Issue a real virtual card capped at amount USD for a specific merchant. Returns the card details and a spend_request_id. Use single_use=true for a one-time purchase (the card auto-freezes after the first charge). Base URL https://mooj-api-277196974190.us-central1.run.app ; send header Authorization: Bearer $JOOMJOO_API_KEY. Maps to POST /v1/cards.

merchant.description: Merchant the card is for, e.g. namecheap.

single_use.description: True (default) = one-time card that auto-freezes after the first charge.

function_declarations.name: complete_purchase
function_declarations.description: Hand Joomjoo a plain-English purchase task and a spend cap. Joomjoo mints a card, drives the merchant checkout in a real browser, auto-handles 3DS, and pays. Async: returns a checkout_id to poll with get_checkout_status. confirm_pay=false stops at the final review without charging. Maps to POST /v1/checkout.

task.description: Plain-English description of what to buy.

amount.description: Maximum USD to spend (becomes the card cap).

confirm_pay.description: False (default) = dry run, stop at review. True = pay autonomously up to the cap.

function_declarations.name: get_checkout_status
function_declarations.description: Poll a complete_purchase run. Status is one of queued, running, awaiting_approval, needs_login, submitted, blocked. Maps to GET /v1/checkout/{checkout_id}.

function_declarations.name: get_spend_status
function_declarations.description: Check whether a card from issue_card was charged. Status is one of not_started, authorized, cleared, declined. Maps to GET /v1/spend/{spend_id}.
